<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|||375}}</noinclude>{{sc|Foelix Ecclesia}}, ''cui totam doctrinam Apostoli cum suo sanguine profuderunt: vbi'' {{sc|Petrvs}} ''Passioni Domini adaequatur, vbi'' {{sc|Pavlvs}} ''Ioannis (Baptistae) exitu coronatur.'' Tertul. de Praescript.

{{sc|Non}} ''ita coelum splendescit, quando radios sol demittit, quemadmodum'' {{sc|Romanorvm Vrbs}} ''duas illas lampades vbique terrarum effundens.'' Chrys. in ep. Ro. hom. 32 in moral.

! style='width: 65px; text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Tiberij
! style='width: 70px; text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Natiuit.
! style='width: 50px; text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Ascen.
! style='vertical-align: top;' |
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | {{dropinitial|S}}EVEN Deacons are elected and ordered by imposition of handes. ''Act. 6.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Steuen the principal of them maketh a blessed sermon, for vvhich he vvas stoned to death, Saul (aftervvard Paul) consenting and aiding therevnto. ''Act. 7.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 19
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 35
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 2
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Saul by commission persecuteth. ''Act. 9.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | In his iourney to Damascus he is conuerted. ''Ibid.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He goeth into Arabia and preacheth there. ''Galat. 1.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 22
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 38
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 5
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Paul returneth to Damascus, vvhere being in danger he escapeth, let dovvne in a basket by the vvall. ''Act. 9.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Thence he commeth to Hierusalem to see Peter, ''Galat. 1.'' Vvhere being in danger of his life, the brethren conuey him out of the citie to Caesarea, and thence to Tarsus. ''Act. 9.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He preacheth in the partes of Syria and Cilicia. ''Galat. 1.'' and at Antioche, vvhere the Christians vvere first called by that name. ''Act. 11.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He and Barnabas being seuered from the rest of the Disciples by the appointment of the holy Ghost, and after fasting and praier, by imposition of handes consecrated Apostles and Bishops, they comme to Cypres, vvhere he conuerted the Proconsul. ''Act. 13.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He preacheth in Lycaonia, and at Lystra is almost stoned to death. He appointeth Priests in euery Church, and returning by Pisidia, came againe to Antioche vvhence they first departed. ''Act. 14.''
|-
! style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Claudij
! style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Natiuit.
! style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Ascen.
! style='vertical-align: top;' |
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 9
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 52
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 18
| style='vertical-align: top;' | At Antioche and there about he remaineth ''(Act. 14)'' vntil the controuersie touching the obseruation of Moyses lavv, for resolution vvhereof he and Barnabas ascend to Hierusalem. Vvhere they are appointed to bring the determination of the Councel to Antioche. And from thence passing through Syria and Cilicia, they teach the Christians to obserue the decrees of the Apostles and Auncients. ''Act. 15.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Doing the same in the cities of Lycaonia and others adioining, by a vision he is vvarned to passe ouer the sea, and so commeth into Macedonia, vvhere he planteth the Gospel. ''Act. 16.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Hence forvvard S. Luke pursueth S. Pauls storie, chapter by chapter, vntil his apprehension in Hierusalem, and arriual at Rome, in this order.
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He returneth from Macedonia by Thessalonica to Athens, vvhere he conuerteth many, namely S. Denys Areopagita. ''Act. 17.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | From Athens he commeth to Corinth, vvhere he remaineth 18 moneths. ''Act. 18.'' and hauing visited the Churches of Asia ''(Act. 19)'' he commeth backe to Corinth ''Act. 20.'' Vvhence he vvriteth his epistle to the Romanes. ''Ro. 15.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | From Corinth he saileth to Troas in Asia, vvhere vpon a Sunday he raised Eutychus from death, preaching til midnight. from Troas he commeth to Miletum by sea, and there sendeth for the Bishops and Auncients of Ephesus, and exhorteth them. ''Act. 20.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | Thence comming to Hierusalem he is taken, ''Act. 21:'' and from the Tribune Lysias deliuered to Felix the Gouernour, ''Act. 23:'' and by him left to Festus, ''Act. 24.'' he appealeth to Caesar, ''Act. 25:'' and so is {{sc|sent to Rome}}, ''Act. 27:'' vvhere he arriueth. ''Act. 28.''
|-
! style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Neronis
! style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Natiuit.
! style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | Ascen.
! style='vertical-align: top;' |
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 2
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 58
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 25
| style='vertical-align: top;' | At Rome he remaineth in free prison tvvo yere, ''Act. 28.'' and then is deliuered, ''2 Tim. 4.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | After his deliuerie he preached in sundrie countries of the vvest, namely in Spaine. ''Hiero. in Catalogo. Epiph. Haeres. 27.'' Him self vvriteth that he purposed so to doe. ''Ro. 15.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | In his Epistle to the Philippians ''(c. 1)'' he minded to visite the Churches of Asia, vvhich also he did. ''Genebrard. in Chron.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' |
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He vvriteth last of al, his second Epistle to Timothee a litle before his death. ''2 Tim. 4.'' being novv the second time apprehended and in bandes at Rome. ''Theodoret.''
|-
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 14
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 70
| style='text-align: right; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 8px;' | 37
| style='vertical-align: top;' | He vvas beheaded at Rome, the same day that Peter vvas crucified. ''S. Ambros. ser. 66. 68. S. Maximus.''
|}<noinclude>{{rh|||OF THE}}</noinclude>
